Indian stock markets decline amid profit-taking and FII outflows

Indian stock markets experienced a decline in early trading sessions, influenced by profit-taking and outflows from Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs). Reliance Industries was among the leading stocks experiencing losses following a previous rally, while gains in IT stocks, particularly Tech Mahindra, provided some support to the market.
